title: 7,000 實用英語單字清單（CEFR A2–B1）
section: 第 2,251–2,300 個單字（CEFR B1 中級）

words.definition: 金融；財務；資助；為…籌措資金

examples.en: Personal finance classes teach practical money management and budgeting.
examples.zh: 個人理財課程教授實用的金錢管理與預算規劃技巧。

examples.en: The tech startup received venture capital to finance its overseas expansion.
examples.zh: 這家科技新創公司獲得創投資金，以資助其拓展海外市場業務。

examples.en: She was promoted to the head of the corporate finance department.
examples.zh: 她獲得晉升，接任企業財務部門主管一職。

examples.en: Achieving long-term financial stability requires regular savings.
examples.zh: 實現長期的財務穩定需要持之以恆的定期儲蓄。

examples.en: You should consult a licensed financial advisor before making complex investments.
examples.zh: 在進行複雜的投資決策前，應先諮詢領有執照的專業財務顧問。

examples.en: The unexpected medical emergency placed a heavy financial burden on the family.
examples.zh: 突發的重大醫療急症給這個家庭帶來了沉重的經濟財務負擔。

examples.en: Open a designated bank account to receive monthly direct salary deposits.
examples.zh: 開立一個指定的銀行帳戶以接收每月薪資入帳。

examples.en: You can check all recent transactions by logging into your digital bank account.
examples.zh: 登入數位網銀帳戶即可隨時查看所有近期交易明細記錄。

examples.en: Never reveal your secret bank account PIN code to strangers over the phone.
examples.zh: 絕不可在電話中將您的秘密銀行帳戶提款密碼透露給陌生人。

words.definition: 活期儲蓄帳戶；儲蓄存款

examples.en: A high-yield digital savings account offers better annual interest returns.
examples.zh: 高活存利率的數位儲蓄帳戶能帶來更佳的年化利息回報。

examples.en: Parents opened a special savings account to set aside tuition funds for their child.
examples.zh: 父母為孩子開立了一個專屬儲蓄帳戶，每月提撥儲備教育學費基金。

examples.en: Setting up automatic monthly transfers into a savings account makes saving effortless.
examples.zh: 設定每月薪資自動轉存至儲蓄帳戶，能讓存錢變得輕鬆毫不費力。

examples.en: Business owners issue commercial checks drawn on their checking account.
examples.zh: 企業負責人開立由其支票帳戶扣款的商業支票。

examples.en: The accountant reconciled the company checking account balance at month-end.
examples.zh: 會計師在月底核對沖銷了公司支票帳戶的所有借貸餘額。

examples.en: Most people use checking accounts for everyday bills and debit card spending.
examples.zh: 大多數人主要利用經常支票帳戶來處理日常繳費與金融卡消費扣款。

examples.en: You can deposit cash into your account at any smart ATM.
examples.zh: 您可以在任何一台智慧型 ATM 自動存提款機存入現金。

examples.en: Tenants must pay a two-month rental deposit before moving into the apartment.
examples.zh: 房客在正式搬進公寓套房前，必須先繳納相當於兩個月房租的押金。

examples.en: River currents carried soil downstream to form thick silt deposits at the river mouth.
examples.zh: 湍急的河水將泥沙向下游沖刷，在出海口處沉積形成厚厚的淤泥沉積層。

examples.en: I withdrew ten thousand dollars from the ATM for weekend expenses.
examples.zh: 我從 ATM 提領了一萬元現金作為週末開銷。

examples.en: The exhausted athlete decided to withdraw from the marathon due to ankle pain.
examples.zh: 筋疲力竭的選手因腳踝劇烈疼痛，決定遺憾退出這場馬拉松比賽。

examples.en: Troop commanders were ordered to withdraw their forces from the contested border.
examples.zh: 部隊指揮官接獲上級命令，自局勢緊張的邊界前線撤回軍事防禦部隊。

examples.en: Daily cash withdrawal limits protect account holders against unauthorized fraud.
examples.zh: 每日現金提款上限能保護帳戶持有人防範未經授權的詐騙盜領。

examples.en: The patient experienced acute caffeine withdrawal symptoms like headaches.
examples.zh: 這位戒斷咖啡因的患者出現了急性戒斷症狀，如劇烈頭痛。

examples.en: Signing the peace treaty led to the gradual military withdrawal of allied troops.
examples.zh: 和平協議的正式簽署促成了盟軍部隊從前線逐步有秩序地撤離。

examples.en: Transfer funds instantly to your friend's account via mobile banking app.
examples.zh: 透過手機行動網銀 App 可以秒速轉帳給朋友。

examples.en: The branch manager was offered a promotion and transfer to the Tokyo regional office.
examples.zh: 這位分行經理獲得了晉升機會，並獲准調任至東京區域營運總部。

examples.en: Passengers need to transfer to the Green Line at Zhongshan MRT Station.
examples.zh: 乘客必須在捷運中山站轉乘松山新店綠線列車。

examples.en: You will receive an instant SMS notification for every credit card transaction.
examples.zh: 每筆信用卡刷卡交易完成時，您都會收到即時簡訊通知。

examples.en: The bank charges a modest handling fee for overseas foreign currency transactions.
examples.zh: 銀行對海外跨國外幣刷卡消費收取微薄的跨國手續費。

examples.en: Blockchain technology records and verifies every cryptographic transaction transparently.
examples.zh: 區塊鏈技術公開透明地記錄並驗證每一筆加密貨幣交易記錄。

examples.en: Check your real-time bank balance before making large online purchases.
examples.zh: 在進行大額線上購物前，請先查詢確認您的銀行帳戶即時餘額。

examples.en: Yoga and meditation help modern professionals strike a healthy work-life balance.
examples.zh: 瑜珈與靜坐冥想有助於現代上班族在忙碌工作中取得身心生活平衡。

examples.en: The gymnast maintained flawless balance on the narrow wooden beam.
examples.zh: 體操選手在狹窄的木製平衡木上展現了完美無瑕的極致平衡感。

words.definition: 銀行對帳單；結算單；聲明

examples.en: Review your monthly bank statement carefully to detect any unfamiliar charges.
examples.zh: 仔細核對每月的銀行對帳單，以即時發現任何不明扣款。

examples.en: The Prime Minister issued an official public statement regarding the summit.
examples.zh: 首相針對雙邊高峰會談的圓滿共識發表了正式的公開官方聲明。

examples.en: Her bold, colorful artwork makes a dramatic aesthetic statement in the modern gallery.
examples.zh: 她色彩大膽濃烈的原創畫作在現代畫廊中散發出極具震撼力的美學主張。

examples.en: Central banks adjust benchmark interest rates to combat rising inflation.
examples.zh: 各國央行透過調升或調降基準利率來對抗攀升的通貨膨脹。

examples.en: Fixed interest rate loans protect home buyers from fluctuating borrowing costs.
examples.zh: 固定利率房貸能讓購屋族免受市場借貸利息波動的財務風險。

examples.en: Car dealerships offered attractive zero-percent interest rate promotions on new models.
examples.zh: 汽車經銷商針對旗下最新車款推出了極具吸引力的零利率購車分期專案。

examples.en: Compound interest is often called the eighth wonder of the economic world.
examples.zh: 複利常被譽為經濟理財世界中的「世界第八大奇蹟」。

examples.en: Starting to invest in your twenties maximizes the compounding effect of compound interest.
examples.zh: 從二十幾歲開始早早投入理財，能將複利增值的滾雪球效益發揮到極致。

examples.en: Reinvesting stock dividends harnesses compound interest to accelerate wealth building.
examples.zh: 將每期獲發的股票股息持續滾入再投資，能善用複利威力加速財富累積。

examples.en: The young couple took out a thirty-year bank home mortgage.
examples.zh: 這對年輕夫妻向銀行申辦了三十年期的青年安心成家房貸。

examples.en: Refinancing your home mortgage at a lower rate can save thousands each year.
examples.zh: 以更低廉的利率辦理房屋貸款轉貸轉貸，每年能省下數以萬計的利息。

examples.en: They finally made their last mortgage payment and owned their house outright.
examples.zh: 他們終於全額還清了最後一筆房貸本息，徹徹底底擁有了屬於自己的房子。

examples.en: Pay off high-interest credit card debt first to achieve financial freedom.
examples.zh: 先清償高利息的信用卡卡債，才能逐步邁向財務自由。

examples.en: The student worked part-time at a campus cafe to clear her college tuition debt.
examples.zh: 這名大學生利用課餘時間在校園咖啡館打工，以儘早還清大學就學貸款。

examples.en: Our country has an immense national debt that requires careful fiscal planning.
examples.zh: 國家背負著龐大的公共債務，需要政府當局審慎制定財政健全計畫。

examples.en: Can I borrow your English grammar reference book for the weekend?
examples.zh: 這個週末我可以借用一下你的英文文法參考書嗎？

examples.en: Startups often borrow capital from commercial lenders to purchase new machinery.
examples.zh: 新創企業經常向商業銀行借貸營運資金，以購置升級生產機具設備。

examples.en: Writers sometimes borrow motifs from ancient mythology to enrich their novels.
examples.zh: 作家有時會巧妙借用遠古神話傳說的母題，以豐富長篇小說的內涵層次。

examples.en: Banks lend money to creditworthy entrepreneurs starting green businesses.
examples.zh: 銀行將資金借貸給具備良好信用且開創綠能事業的創業家。

examples.en: Could you please lend me your umbrella until the torrential rain stops?
examples.zh: 你能先把雨傘借我撐一下，直到這場傾盆大雨停歇嗎？

examples.en: Historical stone walls lend a uniquely charming character to the old city street.
examples.zh: 古樸滄桑的石頭城牆為這座老城街道增添了一股獨具魅力的歷史風情。

examples.en: Paying bills on time maintains an excellent personal credit score.
examples.zh: 按時繳納各項帳單能維持極佳的個人信用評分。

examples.en: A low credit score can result in higher mortgage loan interest rates.
examples.zh: 過低的個人信用分數往往會導致銀行調高房貸核貸利率。

examples.en: Keeping credit card utilization below thirty percent helps raise your credit score.
examples.zh: 將信用卡額度使用率壓低在三成以內，有助於穩步拉高信用評分。

examples.en: You can request a temporary increase in credit limit before traveling abroad.
examples.zh: 出國旅遊前可向發卡銀行申請調高臨時信用卡刷卡額度。

examples.en: Maxing out your credit limit hurts your financial standing with creditors.
examples.zh: 將信用卡額度全數刷爆會損害你在金融放款機構心中的信用評價。

examples.en: The bank upgraded her card to platinum and doubled her monthly credit limit.
examples.zh: 銀行將她的信用卡尊榮升級為白金卡，並將每月的信用額度直接翻倍。

words.definition: 簽帳金融卡；Visa 金融卡

examples.en: When using a debit card, purchase funds are deducted immediately from your account.
examples.zh: 使用簽帳金融卡時，消費金額會直接即時從銀行存款中扣除。

examples.en: Debit cards are great tools for students learning to spend strictly within their means.
examples.zh: 簽帳金融卡是讓初學理財的學生量入為出、避免過度透支的好工具。

examples.en: I tapped my debit card at the supermarket checkout to pay for weekly groceries.
examples.zh: 我在超市結帳櫃檯輕輕嗶了一下簽帳金融卡，順利結清了一週的生活伙食。

examples.en: Apple Pay, Line Pay, and EasyCard are popular contactless payment methods.
examples.zh: Apple Pay、LINE Pay 與悠遊卡皆為極普及的感應式行動支付方式。

examples.en: Contactless payment terminals make transit subway turnstiles move much faster.
examples.zh: 感應式行動支付刷卡機大幅提升了地鐵捷運出入閘門的通關通行效率。

examples.en: The pandemic accelerated the global public adoption of hygienic contactless payment.
examples.zh: 疫情加速了全球各國大眾對衛生便捷的感應式支付技術的廣泛普及與採納。

examples.en: Mobile banking allows users to transfer funds, pay bills, and invest easily.
examples.zh: 行動網銀讓使用者動動手指即可輕鬆轉帳、繳費與投資理財。

examples.en: High security standards in mobile banking rely on fingerprint or face logins.
examples.zh: 行動網銀極高的安全防護標準依賴生物辨識指紋或臉部辨識登入。

examples.en: Rural residents without physical branches nearby benefit immensely from mobile banking.
examples.zh: 附近沒有實體銀行分行的偏鄉居民從無遠弗屆的行動網銀中獲益良多。

examples.en: Check favorable foreign exchange rates before exchanging Japanese yen.
examples.zh: 在兌換日幣現鈔前，先留意觀察優惠的外匯匯率走勢。

examples.en: Central banks maintain substantial foreign exchange reserves to stabilize currency value.
examples.zh: 各國央行持有充裕龐大的外匯存底，以隨時維持本國貨幣匯率平穩。

examples.en: Specialized mobile apps let travelers lock in attractive foreign exchange quotes.
examples.zh: 專業外匯行動 App 讓各國旅人能在匯率漂亮時即時鎖定優惠換匯價格。

examples.en: The exchange rate between New Taiwan Dollar and US Dollar remains stable.
examples.zh: 新台幣與美金之間的匯率走勢保持平穩。

examples.en: A sudden fluctuation in the currency exchange rate impacted export profits.
examples.zh: 貨幣匯率的突發劇烈波動直接衝擊了出口貿易商的實質獲利。

examples.en: Tourists benefited from a favorable exchange rate when traveling across Europe.
examples.zh: 觀光客在歐洲各地自助旅行時，受惠於當時極為優惠划算的換算匯率。

examples.en: The New Taiwan Dollar (NTD) is the official domestic currency.
examples.zh: 新台幣（NTD）是台灣法定的官方流通貨幣。

examples.en: Digital cryptocurrencies operate without central bank supervision.
examples.zh: 數位加密虛擬貨幣在沒有各國央行監管與背書的去中心化模式下運作。

examples.en: His unconventional philosophical arguments gained broad currency among students.
examples.zh: 他標新立異的哲學論述在大學校園學生群體中獲得了廣泛的認同與流傳。

examples.en: Create a realistic monthly living budget and track your daily spending.
examples.zh: 制定切實可行的每月生活預算並認真記錄每日開銷。

examples.en: The city council approved a multi-million dollar annual municipal budget.
examples.zh: 市議會正式投票通過了高達數百萬美元的年度市政建設財政預算案。

examples.en: We stayed at clean, budget-friendly hotels to keep our holiday costs manageable.
examples.zh: 我們刻意挑選乾淨又經濟實惠的平價飯店入住，以妥善控制度假總開銷。

examples.en: Freelancers often manage fluctuating monthly income through smart saving.
examples.zh: 自由接案工作者通常透過聰明的儲蓄策略來因應每月起伏的收入。

examples.en: Families below the national average income threshold qualify for childcare subsidies.
examples.zh: 所得低於全國家戶平均收入門檻的弱勢家庭，具備申請育兒育嬰津貼的資格。

examples.en: Real estate rent provides a steady source of passive income for retirees.
examples.zh: 不動產房產租金為廣大退休族群提供了穩健可靠的被動收入來源。

examples.en: Rent and food groceries make up our largest monthly household expenses.
examples.zh: 房屋租金與日常伙食採買構成了我們每月家庭開銷的最大宗。

examples.en: Employees must submit receipts to be reimbursed for travel business expenses.
examples.zh: 員工出差實報實銷時，必須檢附合規發票單據以向公司申請差旅費核銷。

examples.en: Cutting non-essential subscriptions is an easy way to trim monthly expenses.
examples.zh: 停掉非必要的串流會員訂閱是輕鬆削減每個月不必要開銷的好辦法。

examples.en: Stock dividends and rental properties generate reliable monthly passive income.
examples.zh: 股票股利與出租房產能創造出穩健可靠的每月被動收入。

examples.en: Building an automated online store is one creative way to earn passive income.
examples.zh: 打造一套自動化線上商店是開創源源不絕被動收入的創意途徑之一。

examples.en: Relying entirely on active wages without passive income makes retirement difficult.
examples.zh: 若完全只依賴主動薪資收入而無任何被動收入，將讓退休規劃變得相當吃力。

examples.en: Many young professionals pursue early retirement and true financial freedom.
examples.zh: 許多青年上班族致力於追求及早退休與真正的財務自由。

examples.en: Disciplined spending, frugal living, and continuous investing lead to financial freedom.
examples.zh: 紀律嚴明的消費原則、簡樸生活與持之以恆的投資是通往財務自由的捷徑。

examples.en: Achieving financial freedom allowed her to pursue her passion for oil painting full-time.
examples.zh: 實現財務自由讓她能夠毫無後顧之憂地全心投入自己熱愛的油畫創作。

words.definition: 共同基金；共同信託基金

examples.en: Novice investors often start by dollar-cost averaging into global mutual funds.
examples.zh: 投資新手常從定期定額買進全球共同基金開始起步。

examples.en: Professional portfolio managers oversee stock allocations within the mutual fund.
examples.zh: 專業資產配置投資經理人親自操盤監管該共同基金內部的各項持股權重。

examples.en: Look into the fund's expense ratio before buying shares in any mutual fund.
examples.zh: 在申購任何一檔共同基金份額前，請務必先仔細查閱其內扣管理費用率。

examples.en: Broad-market index ETFs like 0050 provide diversified exposure to top companies.
examples.zh: 如 0050 等全市場型指數 ETF 能提供分散投資頂尖企業的良好管道。

examples.en: ETFs trade conveniently on stock exchanges just like regular company shares.
examples.zh: 指數股票型基金（ETF）在證券交易所公開掛牌交易，買賣手續如同一般普通股股票般便捷。

examples.en: High dividend yield ETFs are exceptionally popular among Taiwanese retail investors.
examples.zh: 高股息殖利率 ETF 在台灣廣大散戶投資人族群中享有極高的人氣。

examples.en: Stable high-dividend stocks pay regular quarterly cash payouts to investors.
examples.zh: 穩健的高股息股票定期向投資人發放每季度的現金股利。

examples.en: The corporation's board voted to distribute annual profits as shareholder dividends.
examples.zh: 公司董事會投票決議將當年度所獲盈餘以股利形式分派給廣大全體股東。

examples.en: Hard work in school paid dividends when she won a full scholarship to Cambridge.
examples.zh: 求學期間的孜孜不倦最終迎來了甜美回報，她順利榮獲劍橋大學全額獎學金。

words.definition: 資本利得；資產增值收益

examples.en: Selling stock shares at a higher purchase price results in a capital gain.
examples.zh: 以高於買進成本的價格賣出股票持股將產生資本利得收益。

examples.en: Long-term property owners celebrated substantial capital gains during the housing boom.
examples.zh: 長期持有房產的屋主在房地產景氣繁榮熱潮中享受到了豐厚的資產增值利益。

examples.en: Different tax jurisdictions apply varying tax rates to realized capital gains.
examples.zh: 不同國家與法域對已實現的資本利得收益課徵不同比例的資本利得稅。

examples.en: A well-balanced investment portfolio combines stocks, bonds, and cash reserves.
examples.zh: 一個配置良好的健全投資組合應同時涵蓋股票、債券與現金儲備。

examples.en: Graphic artists showcase their best creative works in an online digital portfolio.
examples.zh: 平面設計藝術家在線上數位個人作品集網站中充分展示其最具代表性的精選創作。

examples.en: Wealth managers periodically rebalance clients' portfolios to manage market volatility.
examples.zh: 財富資產管理顧問會定期為客戶調整資產配置比例，以從容應對市場震盪。

words.definition: 分散（風險、投資）；使多樣化

examples.en: Never put all your eggs in one basket; diversify your investments.
examples.zh: 切勿把所有雞蛋放在同一個籃子裡；務必分散投資標的。

examples.en: The tech firm decided to diversify into healthcare and artificial intelligence solutions.
examples.zh: 該科技大廠決定跨界多元化發展，積極進軍智慧醫療與人工智慧解決方案。

examples.en: Farmers diversify crop varieties to protect against potential seasonal droughts.
examples.zh: 農民多角化種植不同抗旱農作物品種，以有效抵禦潛在的季節性乾旱風險。

examples.en: Inflation gradually erodes the real purchasing power of saved cash over decades.
examples.zh: 通貨膨脹在數十年間會逐漸侵蝕銀行儲蓄現金的實質購買力。

examples.en: Rapidly rising energy and food prices pushed the annual national inflation rate higher.
examples.zh: 能源與民生糧食價格的急速攀升，將該國年化整體通膨率推向更高峰。

examples.en: Governments enact fiscal tightening measures to control soaring inflation.
examples.zh: 政府當局積極祭出緊縮性財政管制政策，以有效遏制物價飛漲的通膨狂潮。

examples.en: Prolonged economic deflation can discourage business investment and spending.
examples.zh: 長期的通貨緊縮可能會抑制企業投資意願與民眾消費信心。

examples.en: Consumer prices dropped for the fifth consecutive month, signaling lingering deflation.
examples.zh: 消費者物價指數連續五個月呈現負成長下滑，顯示通縮陰霾依舊揮之不去。

examples.en: Central banks fear persistent deflation because it depresses consumer demand.
examples.zh: 各國中央銀行極力防範頑固的通貨緊縮，因為它會嚴重壓抑整體市場消費動能。

examples.en: Higher salaries increase consumer purchasing power for durable goods.
examples.zh: 薪資實質增長能提升消費者對於耐久財的購買力。

examples.en: When local currency depreciates against the dollar, import purchasing power declines.
examples.zh: 當本國貨幣對美元匯率走貶時，進口商品與原物料的實質採購力便會下滑。

examples.en: The index measures the relative purchasing power of blue-collar workers across cities.
examples.zh: 該經濟指標客觀衡量了各主要城市藍領基層勞工的相對實質購買力水準。

examples.en: Store your original printed insurance policy document in a fireproof safe.
examples.zh: 將您紙本正本保險單妥善保存在防火保險箱中。

examples.en: The company instituted a flexible hybrid working policy for all office staff.
examples.zh: 該公司為全體辦公室同仁頒布實施了極具彈性的遠距與進辦混合辦公政策。

examples.en: Carefully reading the hotel refund policy saved them from paying cancellation fees.
examples.zh: 認真閱讀飯店退費取消條款規定，使他們免於被沒收高額取消違約金。

examples.en: Pay your annual health insurance premium on time to maintain coverage.
examples.zh: 準時繳納年度商業健康保險費以維持完整的保障效力。

examples.en: Organic pasture-raised dairy products command a premium price on supermarket shelves.
examples.zh: 有機放牧草飼乳製品在量販超市貨架上往往享有更高的溢價空間。

examples.en: Subscribers enjoy uninterrupted access to premium video and audio content.
examples.zh: 付費白金會員享有不被廣告中斷的高畫質影音內容頂級尊榮享受。

words.definition: 保險理賠申請；主張；索賠

examples.en: File a medical insurance claim along with doctor diagnosis receipts.
examples.zh: 檢附醫師診斷證明書與收據以向保險公司申請醫療險理賠。

examples.en: The passenger made a compensation claim after the airline misplaced her suitcase.
examples.zh: 航空公司不慎遺失旅客行李箱後，乘客正式提出了行李遺失損害賠償申訴。

examples.en: The politician claimed that his tax reform would stimulate domestic manufacturing.
examples.zh: 這位政治人物公開聲稱其減稅改革措施將能有效提振本土製造業景氣。

examples.en: Purchasing life insurance offers peace of mind and protection for dependents.
examples.zh: 投保人壽保險能為家庭摯愛受撫養者提供安心無虞的經濟防護網。

examples.en: The family received a payout from their father's life insurance policy.
examples.zh: 該家庭順利獲發了其已故父親生前投保之人壽保險身故理賠保險金。

examples.en: Financial planners recommend term life insurance for primary household earners.
examples.zh: 專業理財顧問極力建議家中的經濟頂樑柱主力支柱應優先規劃定期壽險。

examples.en: Location and transport links determine the long-term value of real estate.
examples.zh: 地段與交通便利性決定了不動產房地產的長期保值增值潛力。

examples.en: Commercial real estate in downtown Taipei attracts heavy institutional investment.
examples.zh: 台北市精華蛋黃區的商用不動產吸引了眾多國內外法人機構的重金注資。

examples.en: He obtained his license to practice as a certified commercial real estate broker.
examples.zh: 他經過嚴格國家考試考核，順利取得了合格不動產經紀人的執業證照。

examples.en: Many young couples aspire to become proud homeowners before forty.
examples.zh: 許多青年夫妻期盼能在四十歲前圓夢晉升為自住屋主。

examples.en: Subsidized interest rates make mortgage loans more accessible to first-time homeowners.
examples.zh: 政府優惠利率補貼措施使首購族青年成家自住屋主能更輕鬆取得房貸。

examples.en: Homeowners are personally responsible for repairing plumbing leaks and roof upkeep.
examples.zh: 自有房屋屋主必須親自承擔維護修繕水管漏水與屋頂防水保養的所有責任。

examples.en: Saving a 20% home down payment requires years of disciplined budgeting.
examples.zh: 存下兩成的購屋頭期款需要數年如一日紀律嚴明的儲蓄規劃。

examples.en: The dealership required a five-thousand-dollar down payment before delivering the electric car.
examples.zh: 汽車經銷商要求在正式交付該輛全新電動車前，必須先繳足五千美元首期付款。

examples.en: Parents often gift financial assistance toward their adult children's apartment down payment.
examples.zh: 父母往往會提供部分財務贊助，協助成家立業的成年子女支付買房自備款。

words.definition: 分期付款；每期還款額；分期連載

examples.en: The electronic appliance store offers twelve-month zero-interest installments.
examples.zh: 該家電量販商場提供十二期零利率信用卡分期付款優惠。

examples.en: He pays his smartphone plan and device cost in twenty-four monthly installments.
examples.zh: 他將智慧型手機月租費與空機購機款拆分為二十四期每月分期攤還。

examples.en: Readers waited in eager anticipation for the next installment of the serialized fantasy story.
examples.zh: 忠實讀者們滿心期盼地守候著這部人氣奇幻長篇連載故事的下一期最新回數。

examples.en: True wealth encompasses great physical health, loving relationships, and financial peace.
examples.zh: 真正的財富涵蓋了強健的體魄、充滿愛的家庭關係與內心平靜。

examples.en: Taiwan possesses an astonishing wealth of unique alpine biodiversity.
examples.zh: 台灣擁有令人驚嘆且極其珍貴的高山生物多樣性自然資源財富。

examples.en: Philanthropists emphasize that the purposeful redistribution of accumulated wealth uplifts society.
examples.zh: 慈善先驅再三強調，將畢生累積的財富妥善回饋再分配能真正造福社會。

examples.en: Generous wealthy philanthropists donate substantial funds to medical research.
examples.zh: 慷慨大度且富有的慈善家捐贈了巨額資金支持前瞻醫學研究。

examples.en: The tech mogul grew up in modest circumstances before founding a wealthy enterprise.
examples.zh: 這位科技巨擘出身清寒寒微，白手起家創立了實力雄厚富有的跨國企業。

examples.en: The countryside estate was situated in one of the most wealthy neighborhoods in the region.
examples.zh: 這處典雅悠閒的鄉間莊園座落於該地區環境最為幽靜富裕的頂級別墅豪宅區。
